hardware_policy: one fixed node, fixed CPU affinity, fixed memory limit, fixed one-process/thread setting

constrained_resource.purpose: engineering usability under a fixed finite budget

capability_ceiling.purpose: method capacity under a larger but still finite predeclared budget

calibration.freeze_rule: select the two budgets before formal runs using representative-task throughput, startup, search-time, and memory summaries; never increase a budget after seeing formal outcomes
calibration.startup_reporting: Julia/Python startup and compilation are reported separately and their inclusion in wall time is explicit
